---
title: "Sales Report"
format: html
params:
  dataset: "data/north.csv"
  min_sales: 0
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
df <- read.csv(params$dataset)
df <- df[df$sales >= params$min_sales, ]
```

Source: `r params$dataset` — `r nrow(df)` rows above `r params$min_sales`.

```{r}
#| echo: false
knitr::kable(df)
barplot(df$sales, names.arg = df$month, main = unique(df$region))
```
